info.title: Traigent Cloud Best Config Routes
info.description: Backend routes for publishing, fetching, listing, and rolling back promoted runtime best configs.

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Required when replacing an existing best config. Use the current ETag returned by GET or publish.

parameters.name: X-Traigent-Agent-Ref
parameters.description: Opaque ref of the agent being promoted (the `agent_ref` of the session-create 201). Its presence selects the PROTECTED publish path; sent together with X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation. Never a raw agent id.

parameters.name: X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation
parameters.description: The head generation the run captured when it started (the `generation` of GET /api/v1/best-configs/agent-heads/by-ref/{agent_ref}). Compare-and-set precondition of the promotion; sent with X-Traigent-Agent-Ref (protected path) or with X-Traigent-Agent-Id (legacy promotion).

200.description: Existing best config returned or updated

409.description: Publish precondition failed or function_ref conflict; on the protected path head_environment_mismatch, head_agent_mismatch or head_generation_stale (closed refusal envelope).

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded.

post.description: PROTECTED PATH (content-less plan v2.1, phase 0b). A publish is on the protected path when it carries X-Traigent-Agent-Ref or is made within a content_less_v1 session (its provenance names such a session). On that path the Backend requires BOTH X-Traigent-Agent-Ref and X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation; it resolves the agent, run and environment from the authoritative session binding, never from the request body; it keeps agent WRITE authorization; and it refuses with a closed code (best_config_head_refusal_schema.json) and with no publication row and no head change when the capture is missing or malformed (head_capture_invalid), the environment differs from the session's (head_environment_mismatch), the ref names another agent than the session's (head_agent_mismatch), the head moved since the capture (head_generation_stale), or the caller may not write the agent (head_write_unauthorized); an unknown or foreign ref is reference_not_found. Publish and promote are ONE transaction: a refused or failed promotion leaves no visible configuration version, and of several concurrent promotions at the same generation exactly one wins. LEGACY PATH: a publish without those headers and outside a content_less_v1 session, including the existing X-Traigent-Agent-Id / X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation promotion, behaves exactly as before. Closed refusal envelope: ../optimization/best_config_head_refusal_schema.json.
